# cat

## Variables

### default

```ts
const default: LocalCharacter;
```

The cat as one portable character plus its native renderer. Unlike the retained
mushroom, this is computed from the builtin at import time rather than a
generated JSON file: `toCharacter` is a pure scene-graph walk (no `zdog`
import), so there is nothing to keep in sync by hand.
